Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses drug affinity chromatography (AP-MS) to identify targets of tivantinib. Quantification is performed using spectral counting/NSAF, which aligns with a label-free DDA workflow.

scope: Drug affinity chromatography experiments were conducted essentially as described previously.
c-(-)-tivantinib, c-(+)-tivantinib, and ampicillin were immobilized on NHS-activated Sepharose for Fast Flow resin (GE Healthcare).
HL60 and U937 cells were lyzed and total cell lysate containing 10 mg of protein were added to the affinity matrix for 6 hours.
Tivantinib and ampicillin (control) were immobilized on NHS-activated sepharose beads for fast flow resin (GE Healthcare).
An aliquot (5 mg) of protein from the total cell lysate was added to the beads.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material captured via drug affinity chromatography (pulldowns) using immobilized tivantinib, rather than on the whole cell lysate itself.
